name: Humanity’s Last Code Exam
intro: Humanity’s Last Code Exam (HLCE) 是一个极具挑战性的代码生成基准，收录了2010年至2024年间ICPC世界总决赛和IOI的235道最难题。该基准旨在评估大型语言模型的高级推理和代码生成能力，并提供了一个可复现的沙箱环境用于评测。此外，它还引入了“自我认知”任务来衡量模型对其自身能力的认知水平。
org: University of Science and Technology of China, Huawei Noah's Ark Lab
intro_en: Humanity’s Last Code Exam (HLCE) is a highly challenging code generation benchmark featuring 235 of the toughest problems from the ICPC World Finals and IOI between 2010 and 2024. It aims to evaluate large language models' advanced reasoning and code generation abilities and provides a reproducible sandbox environment for testing. Additionally, it introduces a "self-awareness" task to measure models' understanding of their own capabilities.

drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2506.12713. Humanity’s Last Code Exam is built from IOI and ICPC World Finals problems from 2010-2024 and contains 235 high-quality tasks after manual cleaning and validation. ICPC construction manually extracts PDF problem statements, refines formatting with ChatGPT, collects complete official test cases, and filters corrupted, missing, or incompatible problems, yielding 146 ICPC problems. IOI construction scrapes a Codeforces IOI dump, cleans and reformats descriptions with ChatGPT, collects official test cases, and excludes output-only tasks, yielding 89 IOI problems. Evaluation includes code generation and self-recognition: ICPC solutions run in a Python standard I/O framework, IOI solutions use an automated Codeforces submission bot, and models are scored with pass@1/pass@5 from five responses per problem.
